name: University of Oslo
summary: Norway's capital-city research university; one English bachelor's, Technology Systems: Science and Engineering, taught at Kjeller outside Oslo.

handoff.label: Technology Systems: which admission route applies

ib.text: Needs maths at R1 plus a science at 1+2 level: Maths AA (SL or HL) or AI HL covers both. Still at school? Apply via Samordna opptak, which needs Danish, Norwegian or Swedish A, or Norwegian B HL.

apply.via: Samordna opptak, or Søknadsweb without Norwegian

dates.label: Søknadsweb opens (no Norwegian; diploma already in hand) (yearly date)
Søknadsweb deadline: every document, including your diploma (yearly date)
Samordna opptak opens (with Danish, Norwegian or Swedish A) (yearly date)
Samordna opptak deadline (with Danish, Norwegian or Swedish A) (yearly date)

programmes.name: Technology Systems: Science and Engineering
programmes.ib: R1 maths plus one science at 1+2: Maths AA SL/HL or AI HL covers both; or AI SL plus HL Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Computer Science or Design Technology.

notes: The 1 December route wants every document before the deadline, so it suits a student who already holds the IB Diploma, not a May 2027 candidate.
On the Samordna opptak route you are ranked on your school grades, converted to Norwegian points.
UiO says all its other bachelor's are taught in Norwegian, and it runs no preparatory Norwegian course.
